methodologyNotes: Twelve high-search desktop RAM kits (32 GB dual-channel) spanning DDR5 and DDR4. Specs sourced from official manufacturer product pages (Corsair, G.Skill, Kingston, Crucial, TeamGroup, Patriot/Viper Gaming) and cross-checked against live Newegg/Corsair/manufacturer listings on 2026-06-19. IMPORTANT PRICING CONTEXT: the US memory market is in an AI-driven price surge through 2025-2026 (32 GB DDR5-6000 kits that sold for ~$80 in mid-2025 reached ~$300-600 by mid-2026). priceUsd reflects the US MSRP or lowest CURRENT US retail price actually observed live on 2026-06-19; several draft prices were stale pre-surge figures and were corrected or nulled. Where no live USD price could be confirmed for the EXACT model/config, priceUsd is null (a null beats a stale guess). speed_mts is MT/s; cas_latency is the first timing integer; voltage_v is the rated XMP/EXPO voltage; rgb is a boolean. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
